[
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness, as well as for melanoma in situ.",
  "Surgical margins for melanoma should be based on tumor thickness.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary melanoma tumor and in the same operative setting whenever possible.",
  "When melanoma is suspected, the entire lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1–3 mm) margin to allow histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large melanoma lesions such as those on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral skin, and genitalia.",
  "The recommendation for complete excision with a narrow margin has a consensus rate of 100 % (21/21)."
]
